mechanics.reason: Temporary mana-doubling source behavior requires hero/session resource tracing.
Weekly external-dwelling recruitment needs a source-equivalent city/session route.
Current design keeps only native-safe hero progression/stat style behavior until exact source parity is traced.
Grail/source identity is represented through native city/grail-safe benefits rather than exact spell behavior.

War Captives (2026-11-14) replaces the flee-bank Captives (2026-10-12), which replaced Draconic Dominion. After each won battle Homm3DungeonCaptivesRuntime counts 1 captive per 100 squadValue of defeated enemy creatures (+15% with _6 Dungeon Cells) at the shared exact battle-result prefix, opens the post-battle captives screen (Homm3DungeonWarCaptivesWindow) after the native result has applied (fresh army strip), and applies the choice to the live hero: Execute (6/9/12 XP per captive via native AddExp; _2 Interrogation adds Mana = 1.5% of the XP, rounded), Ransom (10/15/20 Gold per captive), Eat (restore 20/30/40% of each winner stack's losses, capped by captive strength, added through the logic party's native AddUnits), Enslave (_3 Enslave Captives: no Gold now, 1/1.5/2 Gold per enslaved captive per day while the hero is in service, count in 20 hidden bit buffs plus one visible buff) and Recruit (_4 Recruit Captives: hire 10/15/20% of the defeated creatures at their normal cost). _5 Slave Markets: Ransom and Enslave +25% Gold. _1 Underworld Tribute stays native data. A legacy flee bank is paid out once as Ransom. No Diplomacy buy UI, no spells. Proof tier: build; runtime unproven.
